# ui::RangeValueProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The RangeValue pattern: a bounded number (a [Slider](../controls/slider.md#uislider), a [ProgressBar](../controls/progress-bar.md#uiprogressbar), a [RatingControl](../controls/rating.md#uiratingcontrol)), in the control's own units. Implement every member.

## range_value

```cpp
virtual double range_value() const = 0
```

The value.

## range_minimum

```cpp
virtual double range_minimum() const = 0
```

The lowest value.

## range_maximum

```cpp
virtual double range_maximum() const = 0
```

The highest value.

## range_small_change

```cpp
virtual double range_small_change() const = 0
```

The step an arrow key makes.

## range_read_only

```cpp
virtual bool range_read_only() const = 0
```

True when a client cannot set it.

## set_range_value

```cpp
virtual bool set_range_value(double value) = 0
```

Set the value (the control clamps it); true when it did (false when disabled or read-only).

```cpp
~RangeValueProvider() = default
```
